name: ActPlan-1K
description: A multi-modal procedural planning benchmark designed to evaluate the planning ability of visual language models (VLMs) in household activities. It includes natural language task descriptions and environment images, assessing correctness and commonsense satisfaction of generated action sequences.
reputation: A recent benchmark that is beginning to be used for evaluating multimodal procedural planning in household settings.
notes: Includes counterfactual planning and uses a finetuned BLEURT model for automatic evaluation.
